name: US cosmetics labeling (FD&C Act, 21 CFR 701, MoCRA)

clauses.text: The label states the identity of the cosmetic (common or usual name, or a descriptive statement of its nature or use).

source.name: US 21 CFR Part 701 (cosmetic labeling)
source.note: Draft paraphrase. Check against the source before relying on it.

clauses.text: The label shows the name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer or distributor.

source.name: US 21 CFR Part 701 (cosmetic labeling)
source.note: Draft paraphrase. Check against the source before relying on it.

clauses.text: The net quantity of contents is stated on the principal display panel in both US customary and metric units.

source.name: US 21 CFR Part 701 (cosmetic labeling)
source.note: Draft paraphrase. Check against the source before relying on it.

clauses.text: Ingredients are declared in descending order of predominance using the standard (INCI-style) names.

source.name: US 21 CFR Part 701 (cosmetic labeling)
source.note: Draft paraphrase. Check against the source before relying on it.

clauses.text: Required warning statements appear where the product or its safety substantiation calls for them.

clauses.text: The label carries a domestic address, phone number or electronic contact for reporting adverse events.
